name: Shimada Kai
source:
Likes: Women, silver accessories, shopping online
Dislikes: Sluggish idiots, fermented soybeans
Hobbies: Listening to American music

Kai is a red-haired high school student who stands out in the same class as [url=/c6508]Yuuya[/url]. He is a model for a men's magazine called Men's Buckle. In contrast to the quiet and behaving Yuuya, Kai goes around intimidating people and doing random acts of vandalism, while being unfriendly to ordinary students; however, he's swooned upon by some of the delinquent girls at Byakudan. Since many girls are attracted to Kai's appearance, there are a lot of bad rumors about his love life. Kai holds a deep one-sided rivalry against Yuuya.

凯是与[url=/c6508]雄哉[/url]同班的红发高中生，非常引人注目。他是男性杂志《Men’s Buckle》的模特。与安静乖巧的雄哉相反，凯四处威吓他人，随意破坏公物，对普通学生也很不友好；不过，他在白檀的不良少女中很受欢迎。许多女孩被凯的外表吸引，因此关于他恋爱关系的坏传闻很多。凯对雄哉抱有强烈的单方面竞争意识。
